question.text: The base year in the title of the current SEBI regulations governing Depositories and Participants is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 20 of the NISM VI workbook supports 2018 as the base year in the title of the SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations. The regulations have been amended several times since then — page 29 cites the 2022 Amendment Regulations, and a SEBI currentness check shows the 2018 regulations were last amended on November 22, 2025. The "base year in the title" remains 2018; the "last amended" date is separate. The Trap: Phrasing the question as "last updated" can be misleading because the regulations are amended periodically — use "base year in the title" or "last amended" precisely. 1996 is when the Depositories Act was passed, not the SEBI regulations. Cross-Exam Context: NISM VI and III-A both track the SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018; III-A may also test specific amendment dates including the November 22, 2025 amendment.
